en: Sepia photograph of an ornate reading room, likely in a library. Long wooden tables with classic library lamps line the foreground. In the center is a doorway labeled "ČASOPISY" leading to another study area with desks and lamps. Above the doorway are large mural paintings of semi‑nude allegorical figures surrounded by books and foliage; the inscriptions above them read "SCIENTIA NATVRALES" and "SCIENTIA SCHOLASTICA". Decorative columns and paneling frame the interior.
